title: ImportPastSalesCallablePayload
description: Command sales.import-past (contracts/commands/catalog.json; #2062 C7). A phone-verified caller with a try-it workspace sends one past night's guest or sales export (CSV, XLSX or vCard), read by the same converters as guests.import-list. Preview returns a report for that night (tickets, sales, sales by ticket type, attendance when the export records check-ins, first-timers and repeat guests when earlier nights were imported) and a fee comparison: Catch's fee from the platform's commercial terms against the fees the host says their current tool charged. Nothing is stored on preview. Apply saves the night as a private past draft event in the workspace, with its guests saved through the guest import review. Send the same file for preview and apply, and reuse the preview's idempotency key.

contentBase64.description: The file's bytes, base64. At most 5 MB before encoding.

event.description: The past night, as the host remembers it. Defaults: the name "Past event" and yesterday in the workspace's city.

localDate.description: Today or earlier, in the workspace's city.

mapping.description: Column choices by index in result.headers, as in guests.import-list; required when result.needsMapping is true.

fallbackTicketPrice.description: The ticket price for rows the file gives no amount for, recorded as the host's estimate.

currentFees.description: What the host's current ticketing tool charged for this night, as the host enters it. Any mix of a percentage, an amount per ticket and a monthly subscription.

excludedRowIds.description: Rows left out of the report and the import, by result.rows[].rowId.
